svg.text: Decoding: the syndrome points to the wrong bit

g.text: A particle flipped position 6 (d2): 1 → 0. The decoder does not know which bit.
Syndrome s4 s2 s1 = 110 = 6 → bit 6 is wrong. Overall parity is odd → exactly one error: flip bit 6, ce = 1.
Two flipped bits (3 and 6): syndrome = 101 = 5 — it points to a bit that is correct!
But the overall parity is even → two errors: do NOT correct, raise ue = 1.

svg.text: syndrome = recomputed check bits ⊕ stored check bits — the binary number of the wrong position
